---
title: "HappyR"
---

This page is a celebration of R. And what makes him very happy: RETIREMENT!

R's last working day: Monday August 31, 2026.

```{r}
#| echo: false
today_date <- as.Date(format(Sys.time(), tz = "America/New_York"))

days <- as.numeric(as.Date("31aug2026", "%d%b%Y") - today_date)
if (abs(days) == 1) {
  days_text <- "1 day"
} else {
  days_text <- paste(abs(days), "days")
}

if(days == 0) {
  cat("Today is ", format(today_date, "%B %-d, %Y"), ". Last working day. R must hand in \nthe laptop, charger, building pass and Amex card. \n\nAnd say goodbye!", sep = "")
  } else {
    if(days < 0) {
      msg <- cat("Today is ", format(today_date, "%B %-d, %Y"), ". R has already been retired ", days_text, ".", sep = "")
      } else {
        msg <- cat("Today is ", format(today_date, "%B %-d, %Y"), ". R has ", days_text, " before he is done.", sep = "")
      }
  }
```
